टाइगर श्रॉफ पर हुए हमले के बाद विद्युत जामवाल का दर्द छलका है।

बीते 18 अक्टूबर को मुंबई के जुहू में फुटबॉल खेलकर लौटते वक्त टाइगर श्रॉफ की गाड़ी पर अज्ञात हमलावरों ने फायरिंग की थी।

इस घटना में टाइगर तो बाल-बाल बच गए लेकिन उनके ड्राइवर और एक राहगीर घायल हो गए थे।

विद्युत ने पॉडकास्ट में बताया कि टाइगर इस वाकये से काफी तनाव में हैं और यह अनुभव किसी के लिए भी सामान्य नहीं हो सकता।

विद्युत इस बात से बेहद नाराज थे कि मौके पर मौजूद 100 लोगों ने वीडियो तो बनाया लेकिन किसी ने भी मदद की कोशिश नहीं की।

उन्होंने कहा कि टाइगर को इस सदमे से बाहर निकलने के लिए पूरा वक्त चाहिए और वो अपनी तरफ से पूरी कोशिश कर रहे हैं।

पुलिस अब तक इस मामले में 13 लोगों को गिरफ्तार कर चुकी है। 🔫

क्या आपको लगता है कि ऐसे हादसों के वक्त आम लोगों को आगे आकर मदद करनी चाहिए? 🧐🤔

ctx.title: Vidyut Jammwal says Tiger Shroff is stressed after firing incident, reveals actor is trying his best to move on
ctx.summary: Vidyut Jammwal said Tiger Shroff remains stressed after gunmen fired at his car in Mumbai, but is trying to move forward.
ctx.text:
Actor Vidyut Jammwal was among the first to post a video in support of Tiger Shroff after shots were fired at the actor near a football ground in Juhu, Mumbai. In the video, Vidyut called out people for not coming to Tiger's aid, attempting to nab the shooters or doing anything beyond recording the incident. In a recent interaction, Vidyut spoke about his conversation with Tiger after the incident and revealed what prompted him to share the video.
Speaking on Ranveer Allahbadia's podcast, Vidyut said he advised Tiger not to limit himself or stop playing football following the firing incident. When asked how Tiger was doing after the incident, Vidyut said, "He is happy, stressed for sure. I was also telling him that not many people have had the experience of someone shooting at their faces. This happens in the army. So, it cannot be a normal experience. Nobody can fathom that experience, nobody can say that this is how you should be. He is stressed, and he has every reason to be. I told Tiger that he has to be stressed because there has been an attempt to murder him, so it cannot be a normal experience. So, he is good and trying his best to get out of this."
When asked why he had posted the video, Vidyut shared that he was upset because nobody came to Tiger's aid, even though several people recorded the incident.
He said, "We were chatting and when he told me that whole experience that he experienced - isolating himself from everybody around. It ticked me off. My first thought was, this is the problem with our country. That nobody does anything. Now, you will have a reason that he had a gun...my thought was somebody should run, where will our heroes come out from? I told Tiger that his driver should have crushed him, some rickshaw guy should have come out. I was not expecting everyone to run away. One hero. My question was, why did nobody run? There were 100 cameras. Everybody had a video, but there was no attempt to do anything. That ticked me off and that was the reason I posted the video."
On October 18, unidentified gunmen opened fire at Tiger Shroff's car in Mumbai's Juhu area as he was leaving after playing football. According to reports, three men arrived on a motorcycle and fired multiple rounds at his vehicle before fleeing. Tiger escaped without any gunshot injuries, while his driver and a bystander sustained injuries and were taken to hospital. The police has arrested a total of 13 people in connection with the case.
